items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I worked with - Edmond Hall's group was there and they later moved to the Cafe uptown.

ctx.x: There you had a group, right?

I did solo. I worked with - Edmond Hall's group was there and they later moved to the Cafe uptown. They had various groups while I was there - Josh White. It was such a beautiful thing to work in the Cafe. I remember times when one act wasn't going well, Josh White and Johnny Garrett would come out and boost us. I never smiled when I was playing and Barney Josephson, the owner of the club, did everything he could to try to get me to smile. He came down, he had me acting like Hazel and all that. Eddie Hayward…
